subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Picking up my earlier email on reactivating your lapsed and cancelled subscribers. A fresh angle worth flagging: productivity trial-to-paid runs about 29.5% globally and 33.9% in North America (Adapty, 2026), so your already-installed lapsed pool converts on warmer intent than cold prospecting ever will. On top of that, app retargeting lowers CPA roughly 38% against prospecting (AppsFlyer), which is why the win-back path tends to pay back faster. We hold out a randomized control so you can see the resubscribes that are genuinely incremental. Want me to size it against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: productivity trial-to-paid band (Adapty) + retargeting CPA advantage (AppsFlyer)
register_notes: Stage 2 EN utility_and_productivity retargeting: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior email; fresh angle = productivity trial-to-paid benchmark (29.5% global / 33.9% NA, Adapty 2026) plus retargeting CPA -38% vs prospecting (AppsFlyer), both market context with verified parent URLs in enrichment_sources; MobUpps randomized-holdout reference carries no figure; no new brands; 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash, no X-not-Y.
